limits: Presence only: an atom is exact when its words appear in the cached source text, drifted when its ledger source does not contain them, absent when that source is not cached, unledgered when no ledger quote shares 60% of its words. Truth is not assessed.
The quote rule is fidelity-scan's: three or more words inside straight or paired curly quotes, never across a blank line.
